title: SLAB: Time-Lag-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling in PPVC Module Factories
abstract: arXiv:2607.11725v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Prefabricated prefinished volumetric construction (PPVC) builds room-sized modules in factories that operate as flexible job shops. A module waits 12 to 48 h after casting, waterproofing, and painting, while its station is free for other modules. Existing learned dispatchers release the next operation before this wait ends, so their plans need repair. This paper presents SLAB (Scheduling under time-Lags with an Admissible Bound), a decision process for dispatchers trained by deep reinforcement learning. Its transition releases a module only after its wait, and its reward is the decrease of a proven lower bound that includes the waits. Training on 10-module orders with halved waits also teaches the policy the station contention of larger orders. translated_title: SLAB：面向PPVC模块化工厂柔性作业车间调度的时间滞后感知深度强化学习
translated_abstract: 预制预装修体积化建筑（PPVC）在工厂中建造房间大小的模块，这些工厂以柔性作业车间的形式运作。模块在浇筑、防水和涂装之后需要等待12至48小时，而在此期间其工位可以空闲给其他模块使用。现有的学习型调度器会在等待结束之前就释放下一道工序，因此它们的调度计划需要进行修复。本文提出了SLAB（Scheduling under time-Lags with an Admissible Bound），一个用于训练深度强化学习调度器的决策过程。其状态转移只在等待结束后才释放模块，其奖励是包含等待时间的可证明下界的减少量。在等待时间减半的10模块订单上进行训练，也能使策略学会更大订单中的工位竞争问题。在三个现有网络上，修复后的计划比同一网络在SLAB框架内的调度长42%至133%。在根据新加坡PPVC指南生成的订单上，一个训练好的策略……
tldr: SLAB提出了一种时间滞后感知的深度强化学习决策框架，通过仅在工序等待时间结束后释放模块、并以包含等待时间的可证明下界的减少作为奖励，显著提升了PPVC模块化工厂柔性作业车间的调度质量。
en_tdlr: SLAB is a time-lag-aware deep reinforcement learning decision process that releases modules only after required inter-operation waits and uses the decrease of a proven lower bound as reward, substantially improving flexible job-shop scheduling in PPVC module factories compared to existing learned dispatchers whose plans need repair.
